sourceMethod: Downloaded official GM 2015 and 2018 hybrid diagnostic tables. Used pdftotext -layout and read primary diagnostic rows including enable conditions, timing, and module sections. Physical page numbers agree with printed whole-document page labels. Rejected incidental inhibit/bundle/index mentions.
scope: Source-scoped monitor explainers only. No code-level vehicle or calibration fitment inferred from document grouping. Generic dictionary labels retained in assignment; OEM-specific labels explained where different.

unresolvedIssues.issue: Criterion identifies rear-left pressure sensor test pulse; surrounding strategy prose also says master cylinder. Article explicitly discloses conflict and requires vehicle-specific sensor identification; sourceReview needs-review.

excludedDubiousDetails.issue: Energy timing text says clutch 1 although row concerns clutch 5; article uses verified slip-speed branches and expressly omits energy-based conclusion.
Apparent unusual rapid-step-response numeric thresholds omitted; engaged response and reset-sequence facts retained.
Difference formula references 250 ms earlier while evaluation column gives 100 ms samples; article states these are separate source timing entries, without inventing unified duration.

sourceGaps: Official GM public diagnostic index retrieved through 2025; no 2026/2027 hybrid diagnostic tables found in official searches.
2015 hybrid source initially had61 remaining code mentions but only five genuine applicable primary diagnostic rows selected.
U01A8 and U01A9 on2018OBDG02 p1323 are fault-bundle references, not independent diagnostic rows.
safety: No high-voltage probing, contactor bypass, pack-opening instructions, hydraulic manipulations or hazardous road tests. Source road-speed pass routines not reproduced in brake articles.
